title: Equilibrium stability for a continuous time scale with discrete uniform gaps
summary: We investigate the equilibrium (trivial solution) stability, also known as Lyapunov stability, of a certain first-order linear complex constant coefficient dynamic equation on the time scale $\p_{α,β}$, which has continuous intervals of length $α>0$ followed by discrete gaps of length $β>0$. In particular, we establish results in the case of this specific time scale, for coefficient values in the complex plane, including where the exponential function alternates in sign.
